 Concert Music Festival 
 Lucho RK to play seven festivals in 2027: Córdoba Live, Concert Music and Cabaret Festival go on sale this Thursday
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 18 Nov 2026, 17:00 
 Updated: 18 Nov 2026 A 4-minute read 
 Evaarauj / Wikimedia Commons (CC0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Three new Lucho RK festival dates go on sale on Thursday 19 November at 10:00 on Ticketmaster: Córdoba Live on 18 June, Concert Music Festival on 17 August and Cabaret Festival, in Mairena del Aljarafe, on 10 September. 
 With these, the Canary Islander has seven festivals in 2027 , from June to September, and in Andalusia there are three nights with separate tickets for his concert. 
 July is his busiest month : Share Festival and Zevra fall on the same weekend, from 23 to 25 July, and Arenal Sound comes straight after; none of them has yet said which day he plays. 
 The other four already have passes on sale : from €49 at Música en Grande, €65 at Arenal Sound, €79 plus fees at Share and €83 at Zevra. 
 Lucho RK is set to spend much of summer 2027 at festivals. On top of the dates he already had confirmed, there are now three concerts in the south, at Córdoba Live , the Concert Music Festival in Chiclana and the Cabaret Festival in Mairena del Aljarafe, which go on sale this Thursday 19 November at 10:00 on Ticketmaster. Here is his festival calendar, with what each one costs and what is still to be announced.
 Festival guide 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 
 Dates to be confirmed · Poblado de Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Córdoba, Chiclana and Mairena: on sale Thursday at 10:00
 All three concerts already have their sales pages on Ticketmaster, with the same opening time and no prices published yet. They are nights with separate tickets, not multi-day passes:
 Friday 18 June, Córdoba Live: at the Recinto Ferial de El Arenal, at 22:00. The Córdoba series already had four nights for 2027, with Siloé, Antoñito Molina, David Bisbal and Melendi, as we reported in the Córdoba Live 2027 line-up . Tickets for Córdoba .
 Tuesday 17 August, Concert Music Festival: at the festival site in Sancti Petri (Chiclana de la Frontera), at 22:00, with standing floor and Front Stage areas and numbered stand seating. He joins a season that already includes Camilo, David Bisbal, La Oreja de Van Gogh and Melendi, according to our latest Concert Music Festival news . Tickets for Chiclana .
 Friday 10 September, Cabaret Festival: at the Centro Hípico in Mairena del Aljarafe (Sevilla), at 21:30. This is the Sevilla stop of this touring concert series. Tickets for Mairena .
 At all three, under-16s must be accompanied by their father, mother, legal guardian or a responsible adult; 16- and 17-year-olds can go in on their own, according to the terms of sale. The same Thursday at 10:00, tickets also go on sale for one of his non-festival concerts, on Saturday 19 June at the Alcazaba Árabe in Badajoz.
 Lucho RK at the Groove Music Festival, at the Navarra Arena, in September 2025. Image: Sarigueyacolorefd500 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0) Lucho RK's seven festivals in 2027
 In date order, these are the festivals that have him on the bill:
 18 June: Córdoba Live, in Córdoba.
 24, 25 and 26 June: Música en Grande , at the Recinto Óscar Freire in Torrelavega, where he was the first act confirmed for 2027 .
 23 and 24 July: Share Festival , at the Parc del Fòrum in Barcelona, where he returns after the 2026 edition, alongside Ozuna and Trueno.
 24 and 25 July: Zevra Festival , in Cullera, on a line-up with Bad Gyal, Hijos de la Ruina and Taburete.
 29 July to 1 August: Arenal Sound , in Burriana, as one of its first seven confirmed acts .
 17 August: Concert Music Festival , in Chiclana de la Frontera.
 10 September: Cabaret Festival, in Mairena del Aljarafe.
 Before the summer he has his own tour, the Sordo de un Pie Tour , presenting his debut album in venues such as the Sant Jordi Club in Barcelona and the Roig Arena in València, which has already added second and third dates in several cities, according to the ticketing listings.
 July: Share and Zevra on the same weekend
 The tightest stretch is the end of July. Share Festival takes place on Friday 23 and Saturday 24 in Barcelona, and Zevra on Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 in Cullera. Neither has published its day-by-day line-up yet, so it is not known which night Lucho RK plays at each. Arenal Sound starts four days later, on Thursday 29, and has not said which day he performs either.
 If you are only going to one of the three for Lucho RK, it is worth waiting until the schedules are published before choosing.
 How much the festivals already selling passes cost
 Música en Grande: Fan pass from €49 including fees.
 Arenal Sound: general pass from €65 including fees.
 Share Festival: General pass at €79 plus €7.90 booking fees.
 Zevra Festival: general pass at €83.
 These are the prices we noted when publishing each story and they may go up in tiers. To compare with other festivals, see our list of 2027 festival passes, from cheapest to most expensive , and the rest of the events in those months in our calendars for April to June and July to September 2027 . We will keep adding his dates to the Lucho RK page .
 ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through the Ticketmaster links on this page, at no extra cost to you. 
 Sources: Ticketmaster sales pages for Lucho RK at Córdoba Live, Concert Music Festival, Cabaret Festival and Badajoz, consulted on 18 November 2026; La Ganzúa, on the Sordo de un Pie Tour; previous ModoFestival coverage of Córdoba Live, Concert Music Festival, Música en Grande, Share Festival, Zevra and Arenal Sound.
